title: Stouffville Summer Music in the Park
priceNote: Bring lawn chairs; local vendors on-site for snacks.
summary: Thursday night concerts return to Memorial Park with indie, jazz and tribute acts, plus lawn games and a mini food market curated by the Downtown Stouffville BIA.
description: Pack a picnic or grab dinner from rotating food trucks before the 7 p.m. downbeat. Each concert features interactive kids' activities, local artisan pop-ups and a twilight sing-along finale. Accessible washrooms and bike valet available. Concerts move indoors to 19 on the Park in the event of heavy rain.
